description:
You are a wind energy analyst evaluating the aerodynamic performance of the NREL 5MW reference wind turbine. This is a well-known benchmark turbine used throughout the wind energy industry for research and comparison.

A complete NREL 5MW project file is available in the sample projects directory at /home/ga/Documents/sample_projects/. This project includes the blade geometry, airfoil definitions, and polar data needed for simulation.

Your task has three parts:

1. Load the NREL 5MW sample project into QBlade.
2. Run a steady-state BEM (Blade Element Momentum) simulation with a tip-speed-ratio (TSR) sweep from 1 to 15 to generate the turbine's power coefficient (Cp) curve. Export the Cp vs TSR simulation results to /home/ga/Documents/projects/nrel5mw_bem_results.txt.
3. Create a brief text report at /home/ga/Documents/projects/nrel5mw_report.txt documenting:
   - The optimal TSR (the TSR value at which Cp is maximum)
   - The maximum Cp value
   - A one-sentence interpretation of the result

For reference, well-designed modern turbines typically achieve maximum Cp between 0.40 and 0.50 at a TSR between 6 and 10.

You are already logged in as user 'ga'.
